statement: Every eleven generic real points lie on at least 240 irreducible real rational quartics.

answer.text: Every eleven generic real points lie on at least 240 irreducible real rational quartics.
answer.qualification: Eleven generic real points; attainment of 240 is not verified here.

source.location: Theorem 1.1 and calculation W4=240, printed p.2

origin.inheritance_basis: The paper computes W4=240 and uses the universal inequality real count≥|W4|.

notes: 240 is a signed invariant and lower bound, not an established attained minimum.
